From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Gupta <tanya.gupta@acme-health.com>, John Lee <john.lee@edgecloud.net>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Live onboarding: runbook playback + network certification window

Hi Tanya / John,

Thanks again for the alignment call last week. We're ready to run the live onboarding / runbook playback for your private deployment (VPC/on-prem) and confirm network certification for the production NAT and routing policies. Proposed window: today 13:00-14:30 PT.

What we'll run in the playback:
- Sequential run of the VPC handoff checklist (control-plane + data-plane)
- Network certification: BGP session checks, ACL verification, MTU and path MTU tests, and traffic mirroring sanity
- KV-cache warmup and verification of prefix caching behavior
- Post-playback smoke: small traffic injection + latency/trace sample capture

Quick asks for the window:
1) Tanya: please confirm an on-site network contact for any immediate router/ASN troubleshooting.
2) John: confirm that the maintenance ACL on your edge is set to allow our test source /32 (we'll provide IPs 30m before start).
3) All: please have the runbook open (I attached the latest draft).

Attachment: runbook_v3.pdf (internal runbook, redlines accepted)
Attachment: acme_network_sched.csv (sample schedule of tests)

If the 13:00 slot doesn't work, propose an alternate 15:00-16:30 PT. We can be flexible but prefer today to avoid shifting customer traffic on Tuesday.

Thanks,
Rafael
Director, Field Delivery — Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0194

--

13:00 PT works for us. I'll be on the bridge and our on-call network engineer (Samir Patel) will also join. Samir's contact: samir.patel@acme-health.com / +1-650-555-3210.

Two quick clarifications:
- We'll allow the test /32s from your note; please post the exact IPs 30 minutes prior.
- For the KV warmup, can you confirm the expected connection count for the test harness? We run a NAT pool that currently allows up to 5k ephemeral sessions.

I've attached our internal maintenance schedule so you can see the edge ACL windows.

See you at 13:00.

Thanks — a couple of edits to the runbook before we begin (I've updated the PDF and flagged the areas we must not skip):
- Section 2.3 (BGP handshake): add explicit timer for 90s neighbor hold; capture MRT dump after establishment.
- Section 3.1 (ACL audit): ensure both ingress and egress ACLs listed; vendor ACL names (Cisco: ACL-REDWOOD-EGRESS) must be present in the evidence spreadsheet.
- Section 4.2 (MTU): include path MTU check with an ICMP size profile; fallback note if ICMP blocked.

Subject: RE: Live onboarding: runbook playback + network certification window

All — thanks. Confirming the plan for the 13:00 PT window (we'll be on Zoom bridge REDWOOD-ACME-ONBOARD; dial-in in calendar invite):

Pre-start (12:30-12:55)
- Rafael: post test source IPs to channel (30m before).
- Marissa: will start trace capture (zipkin + jaeger sample) and ensure logging is forwarding to the temporary workspace.
- Laura: prepare network-cert-checklist.xlsx and MRT capture command sequence.

Execution (13:00-14:00)
- 13:00: control-plane handshake + BGP neighbor establishment (Laura lead).
- 13:15: MTU and ACL verification (joint).
- 13:35: KV-cache warmup: we'll spin 200 light clients to validate prefix caching / cold-start behaviour (target concurrency: 200 connections; ramp 0->200 over 5m).
- 13:50: small production-like traffic injection (1% sample) to validate trace capture and end-to-end latency.

Post-check (14:00-14:30)
- Fill the evidence table in network-cert-checklist.xlsx.
- If any failure in BGP or MTU, we'll pause and triage. We will not promote config changes without written signoff from Acme.

Answers:
- KV warmup expected connection count for our harness = 200 concurrent connections (not 5k). That stays well under your NAT pool but please note ephemeral translation behaviors during the test.
- Test source IPs (will announce at 12:30): 34.120.11.94 /32, 34.120.11.95 /32.

Attachments: runbook_v3.pdf (latest), network-cert-checklist.xlsx

See you on the bridge at 13:00.
Rafael

Subject: RE: Live onboarding: runbook playback + network certification window — post-playback readout

Team,

Great run — quick readout from our side after the playback and smoke:
- BGP handshake: OK. MRT dumps captured (see network-cert-checklist row 3).
- ACL/MTU: Minor MTU mismatch on one transit link (we captured PMTU failure trace). Acme ops already updated the egress policy; validated after change.
- KV warmup: prefix caching behavior observed as expected after ~40s; no cache thrashing. 200-client harness completed successfully.
- Traffic injection: traces show 98th percentile latency within expected threshold (21ms).

Open action items:
1) Laura to upload the MRT and ICMP trace to the share (link below) and close evidence row.
2) Tanya / Acme to confirm the egress ACL name used for the handoff (Cisco ACL-REDWOOD-EGRESS) so we can label the artifact.
3) Rafael: draft a short post-playback summary for the governance board (I'll review).

Artifacts uploaded:
- runbook_v3.pdf (final, annotated)
- network-cert-checklist.xlsx (completed evidence table)
- https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/eng/Acme-Private-Deploy/artifacts/MRT-20261221.zip

If there are no objections, recommend we mark the network certification step as CLOSED for the handoff track and proceed to the next day for workload priming (non-peak).

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Operations — Redwood Inference
